fields.description: Feature flag for the Awards functionality (Award Winners directory, award nominations, and award cards/badges on member, chapter and region pages). Set value to "off" to hide all Awards links and cards. Any other value (e.g. "on") keeps Awards enabled.
Feature flag for the Job Board. Set value to "off" to hide the Job Board link. Any other value (e.g. "on") keeps the Job Board enabled.
Feature flag for the Events Calendar. Set value to "off" to hide the Events Calendar links (menu item and calendar icon). Any other value (e.g. "on") keeps the Events Calendar enabled.

Transition Reports: whether National Council positions (grand regent, grand scribe, etc.) are in scope. Set value to "off" to exclude Council positions from Transition Report obligations. Any other value (e.g. "on") keeps them in scope (optional, not required).

Transition Reports: whether National Officer positions (regional director, candidate chapter director, etc.) are in scope. Set value to "off" to exclude National Officer positions from Transition Report obligations. Any other value (e.g. "on") keeps them in scope (optional, not required).

Transition Reports: whether Committee Chair positions are in scope (excludes pledge/new member educator and risk management chair, which are always required Chapter Officer positions). Set value to "off" to exclude Committee Chair positions from Transition Report obligations. Any other value (e.g. "on") keeps them in scope (optional, not required).
